title: C++ Object-Oriented Programming: Encapsulation, Inheritance, and Polymorphism
analogy: A Blueprint is the Class; a physical house built from it is the Object. A Universal Remote is a polymorphic base interface; pressing 'Power' turns on a TV, Stereo, or Projector according to each device's specific implementation.
simplification_tips: Start with a simple class with 2 private fields and getter/setter functions before introducing inheritance.
